# rCNV

# rCNV: An R package for detecting copy number variants from SNPs data

Piyal Karunarathne, Qiujie Zhou, Klaus Schliep, and Pascal Milesi

**rCNV** was designed to identify duplicates (CNV) from SNPs data with
ease.

![](articles/dup.plot.parrotfish.png)

***For a comprehensive tutorial on the package, go to
<https://piyalkarum.github.io/rCNV/> and navigate to “Get started” where
all the functions and usage are explained with ample examples.***

## NEWS

rCNV is currently developing methods to detect multicopy regions from
whole genome sequencing (WGS) data using maximum likelihood ratios.
**For a sneak peek, go to the section 2.4 at
<https://piyalkarum.github.io/rCNV/>**

## Installation

- CRAN link <https://cran.r-project.org/package=rCNV>

``` R
install.packages("rCNV")
```

- \[RECOMMENDED\] You can install the development version of rCNV from
  [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` R
    if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) 
        install.packages("devtools") 
    devtools::install_github("piyalkarum/rCNV", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

> **Note:** The WGS functions (`allele.info.WGS3` and
> `allele.info.WGS.GCcor`) depend on several Bioconductor packages that
> are not available on CRAN. If you encounter installation errors,
> install these first:
>
> ``` R
> if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
>     install.packages("BiocManager")
> BiocManager::install(c("Rsamtools", "Biostrings", "GenomicRanges",
>                        "GenomeInfoDb", "BiocGenerics", "IRanges",
>                        "S4Vectors", "rtracklayer"))
> ```
>
> Then re-run the `install_github` command above.

Please don’t forget to cite us if you use the package.

## How to cite

- Karunarathne P, Zhou Q, Schliep K, Milesi P. A comprehensive framework
  for detecting copy number variants from single nucleotide polymorphism
  data: ‘rCNV’, a versatile r package for paralogue and CNV detection.
  Mol Ecol Resour. 2023 Jul 29.
  doi:<http://doi.org/10.1111/1755-0998.13843>

- Karunarathne, P., Zhou, Q., Schliep, K., & Milesi, P. (2022). A new
  framework for detecting copy number variants from single nucleotide
  polymorphism data: ‘rCNV’, a versatile R package for paralogs and CNVs
  detection. BioRxiv, 2022.10.14.512217.
  doi:<http://doi.org/10.1101/2022.10.14.512217>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ADnorm`](ADnorm.md) : Normalized allele depth example data
- [`ADtable`](ADtable.md) : Allele Depth (AD) example data
- [`ad.correct()`](ad.correct.md) : Correct allele depth values
- [`allele.freq()`](allele.freq.md) : Generate allele frequency table
  for individuals or populations
- [`allele.info()`](allele.info.md) : Get allele information for
  duplicate detection
- [`allele.info.WGS.GCcor()`](allele.info.WGS.GCcor.md) : Allele
  Information with GC-Bias Correction for WGS Data
- [`allele.info.WGS()`](allele.info.WGS.md) : ClrCNV: multicopy
  detection for WGS
- [`allele.info.WGS3()`](allele.info.WGS3.md) : Allele Information for
  WGS Data (No GC Correction)
- [`alleleINF`](alleleINF.md) : Allele info example data
- [`cnv()`](cnv.md) : Find CNVs from deviants
- [`cpm.normal()`](cpm.normal.md) : Calculate normalized depth for
  alleles
- [`depthVsSample()`](depthVsSample.md) : Simulate median allele ratios
  for varying number of samples and depth values
- [`dup.plot()`](dup.plot.md) : Plot classified SNPs into deviants/CNVs
  and non-deviants/non-CNVs
- [`dup.validate()`](dup.validate.md) : Validate detected deviants/cnvs
- [`dupGet()`](dupGet.md) : Detect deviants from SNPs; classify SNPs
- [`exportVCF()`](exportVCF.md) : Export VCF files
- [`get.miss()`](get.miss.md) : Get missingness of individuals in raw
  vcf
- [`gt.format()`](gt.format.md) : Format genotype for BayEnv and BayPass
- [`h.zygosity()`](h.zygosity.md) : Determine per sample heterozygosity
  and inbreeding coefficient
- [`hetTgen()`](hetTgen.md) : Generate allele depth or genotype table
- [`maf()`](maf.md) : Remove MAF allele
- [`norm.fact()`](norm.fact.md) : Calculate normalization factor for
  each sample
- [`power.bias()`](power.bias.md) : Simulate and plot detection power of
  bias in allele ratios
- [`rCNV`](rCNV-package.md) [`rCNV-package`](rCNV-package.md) : rCNV:
  Detect Copy Number Variants from SNP Data
- [`readVCF()`](readVCF.md) : Import VCF file
- [`relatedness()`](relatedness.md) : Determine pairwise relatedness
- [`sig.hets()`](sig.hets.md) : Identify significantly different
  heterozygotes from SNPs data
- [`sim.als()`](sim.als.md) : Simulate Allele Frequencies
- [`vcf.stat()`](vcf.stat.md) : Get sequencing quality statistics of raw
  VCF files (with GatK generated vcf files only)
- [`vst()`](vst.md) : Calculate population-wise Vst
- [`vstPermutation()`](vstPermutation.md) : Run permutation on Vst
